name: Navajat Eric Ngai
reason: No own site: the site on his Quantum-Touch profile, hknewage.hk, belongs to Hong Kong New Age Centre (founded 2002), a multi-teacher centre where 'Vimal Navajat' is one of several listed consultants; it gives him no page of his own. The centre itself (tarot, Osho meditations, Aura-Soma, Quantum-Touch certificate courses, Gurdjieff movements) could be a future organisation listing; its site is old FrontPage frames served over plain http.
